summary: RMUC 2027 battlefield as a 20 mm layered height field, extracted from the official STEP model and checked against the rules manual.

step_model.name: RMUC2027_V1.0.0.stp
step_model.publisher: RoboMaster Organizing Committee, post 'RMU 2027场地图纸&可移动道具开源'
step_model.note: The publisher states the model is for reference only; where it differs from the manual or the real venue, those take precedence.

pipeline: tools/field_extract/extract_step.py: OpenCASCADE reads the STEP assembly (81 leaf instances, 5.59 million triangles at 1 mm chord tolerance)

tools/field_extract/build_terrain.py: frame from the two fitted floor planes; vertical-ray sampling on a 20 mm grid; solids by winding count, open sheets by their vertical hull; ground and lowest overhang per cell
tools/field_extract/trace_zones.py + build_field_json.py: red-side buff point outlines from manual figure 5-23 (25 mm per pixel), blue side by point reflection; structure axes from figure 4-5; checks
known_limits: 20 mm cells; heights rounded to 1 mm
one overhang per cell: anything above the lowest overhang is not represented
free space lower than 100 mm under a body is filled (hollow decks, recovery slots)
props (bases, outposts, energy mechanism, dart stations, energy units) are frozen in their modelled pose as solid terrain
zone outlines are accurate to about one figure pixel (25 mm); tunnel interior cards are taken as the strip between the two end cards
start poses are an engineering choice inside the start zone
